name: What is the process for getting a shattered window replaced by City Dweller?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a shattered window replaced by City Dweller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an immediate assessment of the damage and, if necessary, emergency board-up to secure your property. Next, we provide a detailed estimate for the replacement, including material and labor costs. Once approved, we order the new window or glass unit. Upon arrival, our team schedules and performs the professional installation, ensuring proper sealing and functionality. Finally, we clean up the work area thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves damage assessment, emergency board-up, detailed estimate, ordering materials, professional installation, and site cleanup.
